footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to CubeSmart: includes $2.5M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 5.3% to $1.1B in 2025. Gross margin was 68.7%, versus 70.2% a year earlier, and operating income fell 7.3% to $444M, a 39.5% margin.
Net income fell 14.7% to $334M, or $1.46 per share. Operating cash flow was $609M and free cash flow $609M, versus $589M; CubeSmart returned $508M through dividends and buybacks.

spotlights.cap: Net income was $334M, or $1.46 per share.
spotlights.say: Net income was $334M, or $1.46 per share.

risks: Adverse macroeconomic and business conditions may significantly and negatively affect our rental rates, occupancy levels…
Our financial performance is dependent upon economic and other conditions of the markets in which our stores are located
We face risks associated with property acquisitions
We will incur costs and will face integration challenges when we acquire or develop additional stores
The acquisition of new stores that lack operating history with us will make it more difficult to predict financial performance
Our development activities may be more costly or difficult to complete than we anticipate
strategy: Maximize cash flow from our stores
Dispose of stores — During 2026, we intend to continue to evaluate opportunities to dispose of assets that have unattractive risk-adjusted returns
